name: Ambiguous Face Interpolant (Red Path)
definition: A piecewise continuous interpolant constructed for Marching Squares cells with an ambiguous face, using the 'red path' of case transitions (0, 4, 6, 14, 15). It solves the problem of defining a continuous surface where standard linear interpolation fails due to topology ambiguity.
summary: The Ambiguous Face Interpolant (Red Path) resolves topological ambiguity in Marching Squares by generating a continuous surface of triangular patches and a central flat sheet, distinguished by its specific case sequence and flat central region.
